name: Lemony Pasta With Blistered Cherry Tomatoes and Crispy Caper Crumbs

instructions.primary_message: Rinse and pat the capers dry. Pick the parsley leaves from the stems and mince them. Rinse and pat the anchovy fillet dry, then mince it. Thinly slice the garlic. Rinse and pat the anchovy fillets dry, then mince them. Zest and juice the lemon. Roughly tear the fresh basil leaves into 1-inch pieces.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup capers
¼ cup fresh parsley
1 anchovy fillet
3 cloves garlic
2 anchovy fillets
1 lemon
½ cup fresh basil leaves

instructions.primary_message: For the Topping: In a small saucepan or skillet, heat oil over medium heat until shimmering. Add capers and anchovies and cook, stirring frequently, until capers have darkened and shrunk, 3 to 4 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer caper mixture to a paper towel-lined plate; set aside. Leave oil in skillet and return to medium heat. Add panko, salt, and pepper, then cook, stirring constantly, until golden brown, 4 to 5 minutes. Transfer panko to a medium bowl. Stir in parsley, lemon zest, and reserved caper mixture.

For the Pasta: In a large pot, bring about 4 quarts water to a boil. While the water comes to a boil, in a large skillet, heat 1/4 cup oil, garlic, and anchovies over medium heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until the anchovies break down and the garlic is browned, 4 to 5 minutes. Add tomatoes, 1 1/2 teaspoons salt, lemon zest, and pepper flakes to skillet and stir to combine. Cover and increase heat to medium-high. Cook covered, without stirring, until tomatoes are mostly broken down into a sauce, with a few remaining intact, about 8 minutes.

Meanwhile, add pasta and remaining 1 tablespoon salt to boiling water and cook until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water, then drain pasta. Add pasta and remaining 2 tablespoons oil and lemon juice to tomato mixture, then stir and toss to combine over low heat to form a light sauce that coats the pasta, 2 to 4 minutes. Adjust consistency with reserved pasta cooking water as needed. Stir in basil and season with salt to taste. Sprinkle crispy topping over individual bowls before serving.

description: This quick lemony pasta with blistered cherry tomatoes and crispy caper breadcrumbs comes together in under 30 minutes with mostly pantry staples.
notes:
Optional substitutions: fusilli preferred pasta → your preferred pasta

Make-ahead and storage: The caper-breadcrumb topping can be stored in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 2 days before serving.
author: Leah Colins
